map.text_display.lobby.changelog:
# 🛠 GLOBAL MAP UPDATE

## ⚙ Technical part and optimization

* **Global refactoring:** The map code has been completely rewritten. A solid foundation for future updates has been created, optimization has been significantly increased, and adaptation for multiplayer has been improved.
* **Animated Java:** The map has been migrated to the new version of the library (`v1.10.0`).
* **Engine mechanics:** Player pushing and **sliding** on bananas have been moved to the "Delta" Motion library.
* **Compatibility:** Custom functionality has been added to support shaders in the resource pack together with the *Sodium* mod (a special bridge mod must be installed).
* Shader versions in the resource pack have been updated (the transition from version `1.21.11` to `26.1.2` has been made).

## 🎮 Gameplay and game balance

* **New roles:** The long-awaited ability to play as two or more animatronics simultaneously has appeared.
* **ym_complex:** The gameplay in this location has been completely reworked.
* **Killer Rebalance:** The animatronic's abilities have been changed (including a complete rework of the player visibility mechanic).
* **Ventilation:** Ventilation shafts have been added to some areas of the map - you can now take shortcuts or use them for cover.
* **Match Customization:** Gameplay modifiers have been added (several to choose from). Events, bonuses, and hints can now be customized or disabled completely.
* **Dynamic Atmosphere:** Random weather and time of day changes added (configurable in the lobby).
* **Minor Improvements:**
* Crawling no longer requires holding down the CTRL key.
* The lights now temporarily go out while the animatronic's second ability is active.
* The number of required generator diskettes has been reduced from 5 to 3.
* The animatronic's attack direction now depends strictly on the direction it is facing.



## 🚪 New Escape Methods

* **Helicopter Escape:** New items have been added - a canister and an ignition key, needed to repair and start the helicopter.
* **Portal Escape:** A completely new escape route. The mechanic is one-time: you need to turn on power at the electrical substation, insert the blue keycard and activate the terminal.

## 📦 New items and interactive objects

* ⚡ **Electrical Substation:** A new large object for interaction on the map.
* 🌀 **Artifact Table:** Allows you to upgrade basic items (for example, it upgrades a regular physics gun).
* 🔫 **RPG:** A secret weapon with infinite ammunition. Instantly destroys everyone in a small radius.
* 🌡 **Stimpack:** Adds one additional heart when used.
* 🧭 **Prototype #1:** Slows down time for whoever holds it.
* 👁 **X-ray Scanner:** A single-use device that highlights an animatronic for 15 seconds.
* 💨 **Smoke Bomb:** Creates a dense curtain at the point of impact for several seconds.
* 🔔 **Bell:** Makes various funny sounds when pressed with LMB/RMB.
* 🧲 **Magnet:** Helps retrieve valuable items from hard-to-reach storm drains.
* ⚡ **Taser:** Has been reworked and is now capable of completely eliminating players.
* 🧲 **Physgun:** Reworked. Now can effectively knock back both survivors and animatronics. Also added its improved **Blue version**.
* 🛠 **Breakthrough Tools:**
* **Hammer:** For opening yellowed safes with brute force.
* **Shovel:** For digging up piles of earth.
* **Screwdriver:** Allows you to unscrew the ventilation grilles in the complex.
* **Wrench:** Needed to dismantle the iron cover near the elevator on the 1st floor (to install the battery).


* 📦 **Frozen Items:** New type of loot. To use them, you first need to defrost them in the microwave on the *ym_complex* map.
* 📼 **Quest Loot:** Added multi-colored fuses and floppy disks.

## 📺 Interface (UI), Visuals and Cosmetics

* **Skin System:** Animatronics now have skins! The first 3 skins have been added: "Custom", "V1" and "V2".
* **Match Start:** The role presentation has become much more epic - instead of the usual text, a beautiful card is now displayed on the screen, and the animatronic chooses one of random threatening animations.
* **New HUD:** Health hearts have been moved from the center to the lower left corner. In the lobby, the health bar is hidden for everyone, and during the match it also disappears for animatronics.
* **TAB Improvements:** New status icons have been added (for example, an eye icon for a player behind cameras and a skull for dead players).
* **UI Elements:**
* The background (tooltip) has been redesigned when hovering over items.
* The description of items that require a long press now displays the exact duration.
* The frame for status effects (poisoning, regeneration) has been redesigned to match the general style of the custom inventory.
* Updated game mode icons.
* Notification text (for example, "You escaped") now flies out with a smooth animation.


* **Model Animations:**
* Smooth interpolation between animatronic animations has been added.
* Impact and shock animations for animatronics have been reworked.
* Player sitting at monitors in the guard house, now has a full a computer animation.
* Security cameras "go to sleep" (turn off animation) if no one is watching them.


* **Economy and Item Balance:** Bananas now stack up to 64 and their texture has been updated.
* **Boosty:** Doubled the amount of available cosmetics. The texture of Boost subscriptions has been updated, and a neat call to support the author has been added to the sponsors' stand.

## 🔊 Sound accompaniment

* 13 new sounds have been added to the soundpad.
* The playlist of radio stations on maps has been updated.
* The sound effects of the environment and some objects have been adjusted and refined.

## 🏡 Lobby and Tutorial

* **Interactive:** A full-fledged board mini-game "Four in a Row" has been added to the lobby.
* A functional **Admin Panel** has been added (activated by pressing the `G` key).
* The geometry of the settings room has been slightly changed.
* A secret pistol can now be found in the lobby.
* A life-size cardboard figure of Ryo Yamada has appeared in the corridor near the representative's office.
* **Tutorial:** The tutorial in the lobby has been completely redesigned taking into account the new items and alternative escape routes.

---

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

* Fixed a bug where one or more players could accidentally become spectators right at the start of a match.
* Players can no longer activate other players' keys if they are simply in the hands of another survivor.
* Crawling now works correctly inside the lobby area.
* The Sands of Time font is now displayed correctly.
* The metal detector model is now stuck to the floor.
* Added new bugs to give more room to fix.
* Security booth doors now play a "jamming" animation if you try to open them without a key (and added a small delay between retries).
* Monitors in the security booth no longer get stuck with an exclamation point after the animatronic's second ability has completed.
* The spinning player head (choosing who animatronic) to a random search.
* The successful escape message is now visible only to the escaped player, not to everyone at once.
* The unnatural crunching sound of bones when falling from a height has been removed for the player playing as the animatronic.
* The death of a player or their kill by the animatronic is now correctly logged as a text message in the general chat.
* Deceased players in spectator mode now see each other's nicknames.
* The compass-locator (Locatorbar) is now activated strictly during the use of the ability to illuminate.
* The display of textures by pixels near the left door of the car and in a number of other places has been adjusted.

尝试在故障仿生机械人的追杀下逃离研究大楼。在“捉迷藏”模式中，躲好并祈祷他没有发现你。
map.text_display.ui.animatronic_desc:
仿生机械人

尽可能多地击杀玩家，阻止他们逃离。
善用有冷却的技能以更轻松地抓住玩家。
map.text_display.ui.map_desc:
两个模式：“捉迷藏”和“逃离”。

在“捉迷藏”模式中，只需要在规定时间内躲好（没有安全屋生成）。

在“逃离”模式中，必须逃离出去。不论代价都要逃出研究大楼。

未来更新：“Nextbot”模式，从AI的追逐中逃离。
map.text_display.ui.escape_1_desc: 使用研究大楼的电梯潜降逃离。需要按顺序给地下一楼的发电机插入3根保险丝，用扳手拆下一楼的面板并安装电梯电池，再在变压室接通电源后即可使用。满足所有逃离条件后，按下 🔻 按钮即可
map.text_display.ui.escape_2_desc:
常规且相当简单的路线：找到总部代表员办公室的钥匙（里面能找到设施主管办公室的钥匙）。这间办公室里有一个保险箱，存放着大门保安亭的门禁卡。只需在那里拉下拉杆（此前需先给大门接通电源）升起大门即可逃离。
此外，要给大门供电，还需要在发电机房插入全部磁盘
map.text_display.ui.escape_3_desc: 略有难度的逃离方法，需要3块磁盘、1根拉杆、直升机操作手册、一个燃料罐以及点火钥匙。磁盘可能藏在柜子、保险箱或室外。在发电机房按顺序插入磁盘，并在变压室插入拉杆，即可升起通往直升机的大门
map.text_display.ui.escape_4_desc: 一次性的逃离方法。你只需要蓝色门禁卡，并在变压室把电源接通到“传送门”。随后下到负二楼，插入门禁卡并按住按钮。此时你非常容易被仿生机械人以及想破坏你逃离的玩家攻击。成功逃离后，传送门将无法再次使用
map.text_display.ui.doors_opening_descri:
你需要钥匙来打开上锁的门。靠近门时手持钥匙按下右键便可打开

对着下方物品按下右键来得到钥匙，并打开门。

需要通过无线电报告
才能升起大门
map.text_display.guide_book.introduction: 欢迎。如果你正在读这些文字，说明研究大楼已经进入隔离协议。本书收录了关于本设施系统运作及紧急撤离方法的关键资料。记住：你的性命取决于你自己，诸如此类，总之，别犯傻
map.text_display.guide_book.page1_text:
研究大楼十分庞大，许多通道都被封锁了。请合理使用找到的装备：

• ꁇ 锤子：砸开铁箱以取出里面的物品

• ꁑ 铲子：检查室外的土堆——里面常常藏有资源

• ꁉ 磁铁：可以从沥青地面的下水道格栅下取出金属物品

• ꁐ 螺丝刀：拆下通风口盖板以便隐蔽移动

• ꁒ 绝缘胶带：用于修复变压室的电子面板，以及修理地下室的发电机
map.text_display.guide_book.page2_text:
除了工具，研究大楼里还能找到其他有用的东西：

• ꁄ 压缩燃料罐：为直升机加油所需

• ꁈ 点火钥匙：启动直升机所需

• ꁆ 彩色保险丝：电梯潜降所需（需按图纸摆放）

• ꁅ 电梯电池：为电梯提供动力的强力能源（插入一楼电梯旁的面板）
map.text_display.guide_book.page3_text1: 所有撤离系统都已断电。在冲向出口之前，先去室外的变压室看看
map.text_display.guide_book.page3_text2: 1. 用绝缘胶带修复接触点（没有它，交互会被锁定）
map.text_display.guide_book.page3_text3:
2. 用总闸选择供电目标：大门、电梯潜降，或负二楼的实验室

3. 记住：电力一次只够供给一个目标
map.text_display.guide_book.page4_text1: 1. 大门：把电源接通到“大门”，找到红卡（在主管的保险箱里），并激活保安亭里的拉杆
map.text_display.guide_book.page4_text2: 2. 电梯潜降（负一楼）：把电源接通到“电梯潜降”。找到 ꁓ 扳手，拆下一楼电梯旁的面板，把电梯电池装进去。下到发电机房（需要 ꁔ 黄卡），并按图纸摆放 ꁆ 3根保险丝（图纸可在二楼的生物工程室找到）。激活后，进入电梯并按下 🔻 按钮
map.text_display.guide_book.page5_text: 3. 直升机：找到燃料罐、点火钥匙和直升机操作手册。在发电机房（负一楼）按正确顺序插入 ꁕ 3块磁盘，并在变压室插入 ꁖ 拉杆，即可打开停机坪的大门
map.text_display.guide_book.page6_text1: 这是一种独特的、仅限*一名*逃生者使用的一次性逃离方法（所以要小心）
map.text_display.guide_book.page6_text2: 1. 从变压室把电源接通到实验室
map.text_display.guide_book.page6_text3:
2. 找到蓝色门禁卡

3. 下到负二楼，插入卡片并按住按钮。持续按住整整10秒，直到系统稳定
map.text_display.guide_book.page7_text:
保险箱有三种：钥匙锁、密码锁，以及卡住的（用锤子砸开，颜色偏暗）

地下室保险箱的密码被分成两半：前一半在档案员那里，后一半在变压室后墙上

保险箱里必定藏有重要的逃离物品，所以一定要打开它们
map.text_display.guide_book.page8_text:
有些物品被锁住了。例如，在负二楼用按钮来平衡管道内的压力

在生物工程室，显示器上会循环闪烁一组颜色代码——在按钮上重复它即可打开保险箱

冰冻的物品需要在厨房的微波炉里解冻（小心，声音非常大！）
map.text_display.guide_book.page9_text1:
大多数办公室都需要钥匙，钥匙会随机刷新在各处

如果你迷路了，研究大楼每层都有一块展示板，上面有大楼地图以及本层办公室的提示。它们能帮你找到方向
map.text_display.guide_book.page9_text2: 利用通风管道隐蔽移动、抄近路——需要螺丝刀才能打开它们
map.text_display.guide_book.page10_text:
大多数物品需要按住右键几秒才能使用——比如医疗包或除颤器。请阅读物品简介

如果队友死了，你可以使用除颤器。它能以一颗心的生命值复活队友。注意：此后医疗包和绷带对其不再生效
map.text_display.guide_book.page11_text1: 据说，在研究大楼里可以获得一件掌控时间的神器……但为此你需要完成某些操作。相关提示可以在大楼各处找到
map.text_display.guide_book.page11_text2: 继续阅读：Boosty订阅如何帮助加速更新以及新地图的发布……
map.item.lore.ability4_1: • 在已死亡玩家的尸体附近激活，
map.item.lore.ability4_3: • 仆从会干扰幸存者，但不会杀死他们。
map.item.lore.ability4_5: • 所有电子玩偶共享此状态。
map.item.lore.ability4_6: ⌛ 爆炸后冷却时间：2.5 分钟。
map.item.lore.mini_ability1_1: • 击中幸存者可将其击倒。退出。
map.item.lore.mini_ability1_2: 从他们的物品栏中随机获得一件物品。
